body: Issue sweep: this looks no longer applicable: PR #2904 (`bac4a96c7`) removed `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step_fit.rs` and the truck importer for STEP files. On `main`, STEP import uses solidcore (`camcraft_geometry::step` and `camcraft_kernel::machining_mesh`). When the mesher cannot measure a face, `machining_mesh` returns `MeshRefusal::Unmeasured` and `camcraft_geometry::step` refuses the import. The refusal says "machining mesh: deviation not measurable: ..." and ends with "re-export the model, or import an STL". The importer does not mark the model as reduced fidelity. Verify does not advise a larger STEP facet budget. Commit `79aaa6982` pins `Unmeasured::NoSurface` in `crates/kernel/tests/machining_mesh_bounds.rs` (`a_face_with_no_surface_to_measure_is_refused_by_name`). The maintainer decides whether to close it.
